## Silicom Ltd. (SILC) `Communications & Networking`
- Silicom shares rose **11.93% to $60.03 on Friday, October 2, 2026**; the available report did not identify a company announcement or specific event explaining that session’s move. (GuruFocus, Oct. 3, 2026)
- Silicom announced on **October 1, 2026** that it will release third-quarter 2026 results before the market opens on **October 29, 2026**, followed by a conference call at **09:00 ET**; this announcement preceded the October 2 move but provided no updated financial results or guidance. (Silicom 6-K via StockTitan, Oct. 1, 2026, 12:24 ET)
- A report published **October 3, 2026** said Portolan Capital Management purchased **126,321 SILC shares at $48.58 on September 23**, increasing its holdings to **288,787 shares**, or **5.06% of Silicom’s outstanding shares**; the transaction was outside the specified window and was reported only as background. (GuruFocus, Oct. 3, 2026)
- The same October 3 report cited a **$60.03 share price**, a **$21.51 GF Value estimate**, a **179.1% premium to GF Value**, and **$3.7 million of insider sales over the prior 12 months**; these were valuation and insider-transaction data rather than a new in-window corporate event. (GuruFocus, Oct. 3, 2026)
- Needham previously raised Silicom from **Hold to Buy** and set a **$60 price target** on **July 2, 2026**, while Weiss Ratings reiterated **Sell (D-)** on **July 30, 2026**; both actions were outside the requested window. (MarketBeat, Oct. 1, 2026)
- Silicom’s latest cited quarterly results were released on **July 29, 2026**, with adjusted EPS of **-$0.16 versus -$0.24 consensus** and revenue of **$23.81 million versus $20.58 million consensus**; no new earnings release occurred in the October 2–5 window. (MarketBeat, Oct. 1, 2026)
- Silicom’s scheduled third-quarter earnings date on **October 29, 2026** was the only company-specific dated announcement identified in the available search results; no in-window FDA action, offering, acquisition, licensing deal, lawsuit, verdict, customer announcement, supplier event, or new analyst price-target action was identified. (Silicom 6-K via StockTitan, Oct. 1, 2026)
- The broader market on **October 2, 2026** was reported higher after a September payrolls increase of **29,000** and August core PCE inflation of **3.0%**; the available result did not establish a specific networking-sector catalyst or attribute SILC’s move to those macro data. (WhenDoMarketsOpen, Oct. 2, 2026)
- No separate after-hours or pre-market SILC price move and catalyst for Monday, **October 5, 2026, through 12:20 ET**, was identified in the available search results.
